scope: Actual view_image inspection of all eight PNGs, repeated inspection of the corrected guide, all text sections/summary/notes and figure captions read against frozen protocol and saved source evidence. Automated every-cell and SVG geometry checks follow separately.

checks.name: guide_markers_and_midpoint
checks.observation: Corrected long opening-gap marker, short boundary-touch marker, initial stop and timed/stop exits lie at their illustrated points; stops have distinct dashed/dotted styles and numeric labels. Midpoint is explicitly never traded; illustration is authored, not observed evidence.

checks.name: aggregate_charts_and_units
checks.observation: Cost/unit labels, signed annual results, separate cumulative/drawdown paths, session and all24hour counts, zero-support heatmap cells, long/short values and partial2026 marker are readable without relying only on color.

checks.name: empirical_examples
checks.observation: Four panels state earliest completed net win/loss selection for both sides, dates/contracts, UTC timing and minute precision, boundary/midpoint shading and entry/exit/stop lines. Examples are explicitly explanatory, not representative samples.

checks.name: prose_meaning
checks.observation: Source account zero fills and whole quantity skips stay separate from one-contract P&L; assumed fees and ordering/time conventions are disclosed. Raw-price gross is distinguished from independentzero-cost path. Missing outcomes/holiday uncertified coverage are explicit. Native parity, Phase2 andH10 remain unclaimed/uncomputed. Full2018calendar qualification and partial2026 agree with frozen auditedflags.

limitations: Actual browser desktop/mobile layout, keyboard, controls, downloads and hosted bytes require their separate gates.
The images do not establish nativeTradingView execution or profit forecasts.
